header.title: Sign in
header.headline: Play Magic online, free, with anyone.

action.registerHint: Free, on the server you pick

status.serverUnreachable: Trouble reaching the server. Wait a minute and try again.
status.passwordChangeRequired: An administrator has reset your password. The server will not sign you in until you choose a new one: use “Forgot password?” to set it, then sign in with the new password.
status.serverFull: The server has reached its maximum number of users. Please check back later.
status.wrongCredentials: Incorrect username or password. Please check your authentication information and try again.
status.passwordRequired: Please enter your password to sign in again. Your saved credentials cannot be used for this account.
status.authenticationDowngrade: The server uses an older password format for this account. Untick “Save password” and try again with your password.
status.authenticationUnsupported: The server requested authentication settings this client cannot safely use. Login was stopped.
status.tooManyRequests: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
status.tooManyRequestsUntil: Too many login attempts. Please try again after {until}.
status.activeSession: There is already an active session using this user name. Please close that session first and sign in again.
status.registrationRequired: This server requires user registration. Create an account to sign in.
status.clientIdRequired: This server requires client IDs. Your client is either failing to generate an ID or you are running a modified client. Please reload this page and try again.
status.contextError: An internal error has occurred. Please reload this page and try again. If the error persists, ensure you are running the latest version and if needed contact the developers.
status.accountNotActivated: Your account has not been activated yet. You need to provide the activation token received in the activation email.
status.missingFeatures: Your client seems to be missing features this server requires for connection. Reload this page to update it. Missing features: {features}.
status.unknownError: Unknown login error: {code}. This usually means that your client version is out of date, and the server sent a reply your client doesn't understand.

invalidUsername.title: Invalid username.
invalidUsername.fallback: You may only use A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _, ., and - in your username.
invalidUsername.rules: Your username must respect these rules: {rules}.
invalidUsername.firstPunctuation: first character can be a punctuation mark
invalidUsername.noFirstPunctuation: first character can NOT be a punctuation mark
invalidUsername.serverRules: no unacceptable language as specified by these server rules: {rules}
invalidUsername.words: can not contain any of the following words: {words}
invalidUsername.expressions: can not match any of the following expressions: {expressions}
